refresh_note: Long-range chart snapshot for every symbol used by the technical tab. The daily refresh agent must regenerate this file alongside 4-fundamentals.json. For each dashboard symbol, write series[symbol].ranges with exactly these keys: 6m = range=6mo interval=1d, 1y = range=1y interval=1d, 5y = range=5y interval=1wk, max = range=max interval=1wk. Each range object has interval and rows sorted oldest-to-newest; every row is [YYYY-MM-DD, adjusted close (or close when adjusted close is unavailable), volume]. Preserve the dashboard symbol keys and Yahoo mappings: NASDAQ:CIFR=CIFR, NASDAQ:IREN=IREN, NYSE:CLS=CLS, NASDAQ:ACMR=ACMR, NASDAQ:META=META, NASDAQ:ADEA=ADEA, TASE:ENLT=ENLT.TA, SP:SPX=^GSPC, NASDAQ:NDX=^NDX, DJ:DJI=^DJI, TVC:GOLD=GC=F, TVC:USOIL=CL=F, TVC:US10Y=^TNX, COINBASE:BTCUSD=BTC-USD. Keep weekly sampling for 5y/max so the static file stays mobile-friendly. The UI runs moving averages, RSI/MACD, Elliott detection, zoom and crosshair from the currently selected range. Added 2026-09-14, Israeli market symbols: TASE:TA35=TA35.TA (Yahoo), TASE:TA125=^TA125.TA (Yahoo), IBI:2126=אינדקס תשתיות לאומיות ישראל (IBI index 2126, not on Yahoo/CNBC), IBI:5143078=קרן אי.בי.איי מניות תעשיית ייצור החשמל ישראל (IBI mutual fund, established 2026-07-21 — no standalone IBI electricity index exists; the fund is the tradable referent the user means). IBI series come from Bizportal's public endpoint: GET https://www.bizportal.co.il/ajax/biz_papers_helper.ashx?action=get_paper_yearly_graph&request_type=2&paper_id=<2126|5143078>&period=6&page_number=<0..N-1> with headers User-Agent, X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest and cookies obtained by first loading the index page (e.g. /capitalmarket/indices/transactions/2126). Response format: '~<page_count>^<json array of {DateObj:YYYYMMDD, Date:DD/MM/YYYY, Rate, ChangeInPercent}>'; pages hold 15 rows each; period=6 returns about five years of end-of-day rows (Bizportal's longest window — treat it as both 5y and max). Quirks: IBI data is end-of-day only and may lag to the last published trading day (TASE trades Sunday-Thursday, closed on Jewish holidays); the array can contain a duplicated final row — dedupe by date; volume is unavailable, write 0; the fund's full history starts 2026-07-31, so all four of its ranges hold the same daily rows with interval 1d. Overview cards: TA35/TA125 also have live CNBC quotes (.TA35/.TA125); IBI cards are snapshot-only from data.json with a per-quote 'd' field carrying the last trading day (D.M format) shown on the card. Added 2026-09-14 (bonds): TVC:US02Y = FRED DGS2 daily CSV (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DGS2 - official US Treasury 2Y constant-maturity yield; business days only, published with a one-business-day lag, weekend gaps of up to 3 days are normal; skip "." rows; 6m/1y daily rows, 5y/max weekly last-of-week; volume 0). TVC:US30Y = ^TYX on Yahoo, same recipe as TVC:US10Y=^TNX. TASE:1227784 = ממשלתי שקלי 1035, the traded Israeli ~10Y shekel gov benchmark (matures 10/2035, duration ~7.5Y): PRICE history from the same Bizportal endpoint as the IBI series, paper_id=1227784, all pages, dedupe by date; Rate is the price per 100 face value, volume 0. The bond first traded 2025-10, so its 5y and max ranges hold the same daily rows with interval 1d. Overview cards show YIELDS in percent for these symbols, but the TASE:1227784 chart is the bond price, not the yield - series.name says (מחיר) on purpose.
